select code, close from max.prices where trade_date = cast(:d as date) order by code

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import dayPrices from max::market output application/java --- dayPrices(vars.day, vars.prev, {(vars.published map {($.code): $.price_move_pct})})

db:bulk-insert.db:sql: insert into max.prices (code, trade_date, close, volume) values (:code, cast(:trade_date as date), :close, :volume) on conflict (code, trade_date) do nothing

http:request.http:body: #[output application/json --- {date: vars.day, orders: vars.dayOrders, closes: vars.closes}]

select announcement_id from max.planned_events where cast(published_at as date) = cast(:d as date) order by announcement_id

db:insert.db:sql: insert into max.announcements (announcement_id, code, published_at, kind, title, price_move_pct) select announcement_id, code, published_at, kind, title, price_move_pct from max.planned_events where cast(published_at as date) = cast(:d as date)

db:update.db:sql: update max.business_clock set today = cast(:d as date)

db:insert.db:sql: insert into max.audit_log (actor, action, target, detail) values ('system:clock', 'advance', :d, cast(:detail as jsonb))
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{d: vars.day, detail: write({prices: sizeOf(vars.dayPriceRows), orders: sizeOf(vars.dayOrders), trades: sizeOf(vars.dayTrades), announcements: vars.todays map $.announcement_id}, 'application/json', {indent: false})}]

set-payload.value: #[{date: vars.day, prices: sizeOf(vars.dayPriceRows), trades: vars.dayTrades map ($.trade_id ++ ' ' ++ $.customer_id ++ ' ' ++ $.code ++ ' ' ++ $.side ++ ' ' ++ ($.qty as String) ++ ' @ ' ++ ($.price as String)), missingFills: vars.fillResult.missing, announcements: vars.todays map $.announcement_id, raised: vars.raised map $.alert_id}]
